output.reason: On its own, the cited bullet [ev-30639b22a58c] is just a metric name. But the section intro it belongs to [ev-1f419676f177] says what happens to that list. Metrics that started with `cortex_` change in this release to start with `loki_`, because the default `metrics_namespace` is `loki`. Setting `metrics_namespace` to `cortex` keeps the old prefix, though that setting is deprecated and will be removed in the next minor release. That is enough to write the assertion: the subject is this metric, the change is a rename to `loki_query_scheduler_queue_duration_seconds_count`, exposure is any setup that leaves `metrics_namespace` at its `loki` default, and the consequence is that the metric is only published under the new name.
